<translate>
'''Namek''' (Planet Namek, dimension id <code>dragonminez:namek</code>) is the home planet of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekians]]: a green-skied world of Ajissa forests and blue waters. It's a full mining world and holds the Namek Dragon Balls that summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], Frieza's occupying army, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] raid and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] inside the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity ==
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config|gravityPerWorld}}
<translate>
Namek has normal gravity (×1.0) by default, the same as Earth.
</translate>

<translate>
== Biomes ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Ajissa Plains''': home of Frieza's Ship, the Ajissa-style Namekian villages and Frieza's soldiers.
* '''Sacred Land''': the Grand Elder's region, with the Grand Elder's House and the Sacred-style villages.
* '''Namekian Rivers''': the planet's waterways, where Giant Fish and Namek frogs live.
</translate>

<translate>
== Ores and resources ==
</translate>
<translate>
Namek has the '''full ore set''' embedded in Namek stone (and its deepslate variants): coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald, so it's a good place to mine vanilla resources.
</translate>

<translate>
* '''Kikono Ore''' is exclusive to Namek. It drops '''Kikono Shards''', the base material for Kikono gear (Kikono Stick, String and Cloth) and the armor-crafting recipes. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Kikono Materials|Kikono Materials]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]].
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Debris]]''' is a rare ore that generates like Ancient Debris, in small veins scattered underground, with a low chance. The drained ground around the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] also hides some.
</translate>

<translate>
== Creatures and NPCs ==
</translate>
{{Main|Bestiary}}
<translate>
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namek Frog|Namek frogs]]''' (and their rare Ginyu variant) are harmless wildlife.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]]''' sell general goods in the villages, including a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for 16 emeralds.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]]''' defend the villages.
* The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]]''' lives in Ajissa villages and sells treasure maps to [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]].
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza's Soldiers]]''' are hostile invaders that spawn in the Ajissa Plains and the Sacred Land.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]]''': while players are near a Namekian village, small groups (up to 3 per village) show up on its outskirts and march on it.
* '''Metal Cooler patrols''': around the Big Gete Star, up to 2 patrols (a Metal Cooler scout with 2–3 Gete Robots) roam near players.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Giant Fish|Giant Fish]] and vanilla water life (fish, squid) live in the rivers.
</translate>

<translate>
== Dragon Balls ==
</translate>
{{Main|Porunga}}
<translate>
The seven Namek Dragon Balls are scattered around Namek's world spawn. Find them with the Namek [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] and bring them together to summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], who grants three wishes per summon. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]] has a separate set of three Dragon Balls that also summons Porunga (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm#Demon Realm Dragon Balls|Demon Realm]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting there ==
</translate>
<translate>
Travel by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]]: the '''Namek''' destination is always available and lands you at the same X, Y and Z you left from. In the story, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] ends with you repairing Vegeta's pod and flying to Namek, and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] takes place here. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] also come back to Namek.
</translate>
